sources.title: Kontrollera kylarvätskenivån
sources.version: MQ4 / 2022 / Swedish manual; live manufacturer edition, no revision date shown
sources.locator: VIKTIGT: Ta bort kylarlocket; pressure-release explanation and following warning; VARNING: Kylarlock
sources.excerpt: Het kylvätska och ånga kan strömma ut och orsaka allvarliga brännskador.
sources.supports: Never remove radiator cap while engine/radiator is hot or running; pressure can remain even engine off; pressure release can expel hot liquid/steam causing severe burns.
sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV searches for kylarlock, hot coolant, cooling-system pressure and burns found no exact technical warning. Approved manufacturer fallback R-COOLANT gives complete mechanism.
sources.scope_limits: Manufacturer technical warning for a conventional pressurised cooling system. Actual radiator/expansion-tank layout and stopping instructions vary: use own handbook/recovery advice. Do not generalise Kia opening steps, refill quantities/mixture, fan/battery procedure or fixed waiting time. The lesson gives no roadside cap-opening/repair instructions.

sources.title: Om du får stopp på bilen – varna, lämna och larma
sources.supports: Motorway/2+1-road protect people from traffic, safest available stopping place, leave car/road and call recovery; 112 for danger to life.
sources.scope_limits: Preferred agency scene-safety support; not coolant technical evidence. Motorway/2+1-road advice not universal tunnel waiting instruction. No numerical triangle distance added by G10.

sources.title: Säkerhet i vägtunnlar
sources.locator: Om bilen går sönder eller om det händer en olycka; Om det brinner
sources.excerpt: Om läget är akut: Lämna bilen
sources.supports: Non-urgent tunnel: stay in car/protected nearby while getting help; urgent/fire: exit to nearest emergency exit and summon help.
sources.scope_limits: Agency scene-safety cross-link only, not technical cooling-system instruction. Smoke/fire urgent; do not diagnose roadside source before responding to immediate danger.

claims.required_statement_to_verify: Explain why opening a hot coolant cap can release pressurised hot fluid/steam and cause burns.

source_searches.finding: No exact coolant-cap pressure/burn passage found. Direct TRV breakdown and tunnel pages selected for scene safety; Kia handbook only for missing technical mechanism.
